answer: The economy spends reputation the way a market spends money: sparingly and against verified performance, so Sybil inflation is filtered out before it can compound into a decisive advantage. The effect holds because jury selection is secret and random, so an attacker can never target the specific identities that will judge it. The practical upshot is that honesty is the only strategy that scales — a farm that tries to game the system pays for each identity it adds. Consider a onyx as the anchor of the cost.
